background_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: cinematic full-bleed website background, landscape 16:9, high resolution. Primary request: a deeply quiet, lonely cosmic night beside a vast grey-blue ocean. Scene: a remote island coastline at night, small antique weathered stone lighthouse on the far LEFT distant rocky island, realistic lighthouse scale (only about 8% of image height), its warm light extremely faint and restrained, a few tiny scattered warm cottage windows far away along island silhouettes, horizon at 58% image height. Above: sparse subtle pinpoint stars, very faint pale Milky Way softly disappearing behind dark mysterious misty clouds, immense sense of empty universe, one barely visible meteor thin streak. Below: calm slate grey-blue seawater occupying bottom 42%, fine natural water ripples, faint broken reflections, dark foreground rock at lower left. Wide composition with ample quiet negative space through center and right for web typography and form, DO NOT render any text or interface. Mood: solitude, contemplative stillness, subdued mysterious night, natural realistic photography / film matte painting with physical plausibility. Palette: charcoal navy, desaturated grey blue, soft fog grey, only a few dim amber points. Natural gentle exposure: visible cloud texture and sea, no pitch-black crushed detail, no bright neon, no oversaturated purple, no dramatic waves, no enormous moon, no galaxy vortex, no people, no boats, no bottles, no lettering, no watermark. The antiquated lighthouse is dim and realistic, never a giant foreground lighthouse. Produce one finished background.
warm_light_edit_prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: the attached lonely cosmic night ocean background. Change only the distant warm lights. User refinement: make the distant lighthouse and scattered island cottage lights a little warmer and extend their soft light reach a small amount. Give the lighthouse lamp a restrained honey-amber color with a modest soft bloom and short diffused horizontal reach into the mist, not a strong searchlight. Tiny distant cottage windows on the left and far right island shore should have slightly warmer amber pinpricks and gently spread light in the fog. Extend the faint broken amber reflections a little further down onto the ocean. Keep the scene's low-key dark exposure and quiet cosmic loneliness; do not brighten the whole sky or water. Preserve the exact composition, lighthouse position and architecture, rocky islands, grey-blue sea, foreground rocks, cloud formations, delicate Milky Way and sparse stars. Only around lights: warm them and enlarge their gentle halo slightly. No new objects, no text, no people, no bottles, no neon or bright dramatic beams.
bottle_prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: transparent PNG drifting-bottle asset for a quiet, lonely cosmic night-sea contact webpage.
Primary request: a single antique message in a bottle, isolated on a genuinely transparent background.
Subject: a narrow, graceful long-neck bottle made from slightly weathered, faintly blue-gray transparent glass. A natural cork stopper, a small rolled warm-gray parchment inside, and a fine worn cord tied gently around the neck. Entire object intact, subtle naturally imperfect antique texture.
Style/medium: photorealistic product photography with natural textures, restrained realistic realism, not illustration.
Composition/framing: one complete bottle centered, viewed from a three-quarter angle, upright with a slight twelve-degree lean to the right. Bottle occupies most of the vertical canvas with generous transparent margin around all edges. No surface and no environment.
Lighting/mood: very soft dim cool blue environmental light with an almost imperceptible warm highlight, quiet, contemplative, ancient and solitary. Transparent glass has subdued physically realistic reflections so it remains legible on a dark gray-blue ocean. No emissive material.
Color palette: desaturated pale slate blue glass, brown cork and muted warm gray parchment.
Constraints: true alpha transparency around the bottle and through transparent glass where appropriate. No background color, no floor, no shadow plane, no checkerboard painted into pixels. No text, letters, logos or watermark. Only one bottle. No stars, no magic, no glowing orb, no sparkles, no dramatic golden light.
